name: bigshark
description: A platform-neutral C++23 Texas Hold'em decision and GTO engine with typed adapters.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:ts && npm run check:source-policy:compiled && npm run proto:check && npm run check:docs:compiled && npm run check:rfc:compiled && npm run test:node:compiled
scripts.check:docs: npm run build:ts --silent && npm run check:docs:compiled
scripts.check:rfc: npm run build:ts --silent && npm run check:rfc:compiled
scripts.check:source-policy: npm run build:ts --silent && npm run check:source-policy:compiled
scripts.proto:check: npm run proto:lint && npm run proto:format:check && npm run proto:breaking && npm run proto:generate && npm run proto:typecheck && npm run proto:test
scripts.proto:generate: npm run proto:toolchain --silent && buf generate --template proto/buf.gen.yaml
scripts.proto:test:generated: npm run proto:generate --silent && npm run proto:test
scripts.proto:update-golden: npm run proto:generate && tsc -p proto/tsconfig.json && node build/generated/test-js/proto/tests/generate-golden.js
scripts.test:node: npm run build:ts && npm run check:source-policy:compiled && npm run test:node:compiled
